column7: the Joy-Con screen, then the Start menu idling: no input, a fresh save
A fresh save: A at 25 s on the Start menu begins the game, and the real-time opening cutscene plays (Bowser's airship)
A fresh save into play (the profile's route): Start, the opening, then the Look Around hint answered on the ship; the game saves at about frame 9,900. Run with --keep-save

a downloaded save in the Metro Kingdom: A through the Joy-Con screen, the update notices (the save predates them; one A a page, some swallowed while a page slides in) and Continue, then Mario standing by the Odyssey in New Donk City
